title: Organized courses with saved learning places
summary: A dedicated course library groups courses by learning area, shows progress and started courses, and resumes each course in its own context.

changes.detail: Course library with four ordered subject groups, course search, All/My/Completed filters, progress bars and start/continue/outline actions.
Save per-course lesson checkpoints in existing persistent drafts; preserve explicit course context when resuming shared lessons and keep previous progress.
Learn tab now opens organized courses. Home and My learning show a common continuation card with lesson position and saved stage; exploration remains accessible.
